recent.text: Maurice said Vilmanis' continued growth has been one of the few good things to come out of all the injuries. "The silver lining to all this is we've got a different Sandis Vilmanis than we had a year ago at this time. ... He's got lots of confidence. He looks strong."

recent.quoted_text: Maurice said plan is to go back to Verhaeghe/Barkov/Reinhart when Barkov returns. He doesn't want to break up the Luostarinen/Bennett/Vilmanis line, but might have to when Marchand returns. "I'm not complaining," he said.

recent.text: The #FlaPanthers will have Cole Reinhardt on waivers today, a first move toward getting Sasha Barkov back perhaps as soon as Wednesday vs. #Sens. ‘It’s possible,’ Paul Maurice said. Brad Marchand could be back as well. https://t.co/ty16IaqnE2
recent.author: George Richards

recent.text: Maurice says Matthew Tkachuk is dealing with an injury that’s “going to get better over time and is not a concern.” Not at risk of missing any games, but likely will skip some more practices like he’s done recently.
recent.author: Jameson Olive

recent.text: Maurice says Barkov and Marchand are both just waiting for final clearance. He’s very happy with where they’re at. Wednesday vs. Ottawa is a possibility for at least one of them if Tuesday’s practice goes well. We’re close.
recent.author: Jameson Olive

recent.text: Paul Maurice says a Barkov return Wednesday is realistic; first roster move to get Barkov off LTIR comes today at 2 with Cole Reinhardt on waivers. Marchand could be back Wednesday as well.
